data.tailoredTitle: AI & Data Science Engineering Student | Machine Learning & Python Specialist
data.tailoredSummary: Final-year engineering student at EILCO specializing in AI and Data Science with a strong background in CPGE TSI. Proven expertise in developing scalable Python pipelines, containerized workflows, and machine learning models (PyTorch, RAG). Fluent in English (C1, TOEIC 905), seeking to contribute to experimental data analysis at CERN as a Computing & Machine Learning Technical Student.

bullets: Developed a scalable Python API using FastAPI and Docker to compute cosine similarities via Word2Vec with sub-40ms latency.
Containerized and deployed the microservice ensuring robust performance and seamless integration into automated CI/CD workflows.
Engineered an advanced Retrieval-Augmented Generation pipeline utilizing PyTorch and Pydantic for rigorous data validation.
Optimized prompt engineering and data filtering techniques to achieve a hallucination rate of less than 2% in experimental data extraction tasks.

data.coverLetter:
Dear Recruitment Committee,

I am writing to express my strong interest in the Computing & Machine Learning Technical Student position at CERN. As a final-year engineering student at EILCO specializing in Artificial Intelligence and Data Science, with a rigorous foundation from CPGE TSI, I am eager to apply my technical expertise to support the complex data processing needs of world-class scientific experiments.

Throughout my academic and project experience, I have focused on building scalable, reliable, and high-performance software systems. Notably, I developed VectorWord, a containerized Python application leveraging FastAPI and Docker to deliver sub-40ms inference latency, and a robust RAG pipeline utilizing PyTorch and Pydantic that successfully maintained a hallucination rate below 2%. These projects demonstrate my capability to design and optimize the exact type of scalable Python pipelines and machine learning workflows required for experimental data analysis at CERN.

Furthermore, my strong analytical background, combined with a C1 professional proficiency in English (TOEIC 905/990), enables me to collaborate effectively within multidisciplinary, international research teams. I am accustomed to rigorous problem-solving environments and am fully prepared to commit to the demands of this technical student role, whether operating on-site or in a hybrid framework.

I welcome the opportunity to discuss how my background in machine learning and software engineering aligns with the mission and technological challenges of CERN.

Yours sincerely,

Badroudine Bacar

title: Machine Learning Engineer Intern

data.tailoredSummary: Étudiant en dernière année d'école d'ingénieurs (Bac+5, spécialité IA & Data Science) à l'EILCO, issu de CPGE TSI. Solide expertise dans la conception d'assistants génératifs, de microservices performants sous FastAPI et Docker, et de pipelines RAG robustes. Anglais courant (TOEIC 905/990, niveau C1). Motivé pour rejoindre Swisscom afin de contribuer au développement de solutions d'intelligence artificielle générative à forte valeur ajoutée.

bullets: Developpement et deploiement d'un microservice de calcul de similarite semantique sous FastAPI conteneurise avec Docker.
Optimisation des embeddings Word2Vec et de la distance cosinus pour garantir une latence d'inference inferieure a 40ms.
Conception d'un pipeline de generation amelioree par recuperation integrant des techniques de Few-Shot Prompting.
Validation stricte des structures de donnees avec Pydantic pour maintenir un taux d'hallucination inferieur a 2%.

data.coverLetter:
Madame, Monsieur,

Actuellement en derniere annee d'ecole d'ingenieurs a l'EILCO avec une specialisation en Intelligence Artificielle et Data Science, et issu d'une formation rigoureuse en CPGE TSI, je vous adresse ma candidature pour le poste de Machine Learning Engineer Intern chez Swisscom. Particulierement attire par votre volonte de batir des assistants en IA generative et des microservices robustes, je souhaite mettre mes competences techniques au service de vos equipes.

Au cours de mon parcours academique et de mes projets recents, j'ai developpe une forte expertise pratique dans le developpement de microservices hautement performants en utilisant FastAPI et Docker. J'ai notamment concu une application de traitement semantique a faible latence (inferieure a 40ms) ainsi qu'un pipeline RAG avance integrant le Few-Shot Prompting et le typage strict Pydantic, permettant de reduire le taux d'hallucination a moins de 2 pourcent. Ces realisations illustrent ma capacite a concevoir des systemes d'IA fiables, scalables et directement deployables en production.

Maitrisant l'anglais a un niveau professionnel (TOEIC 905/990, niveau C1), je suis pleinement operationnel pour evoluer dans un environnement international. Par ailleurs, je suis tout a fait ouvert et disponible pour travailler selon le rythme hybride propose (deux a trois jours de teletravail par semaine) tout en integrant vos equipes en presentiel sur site.

Rigeur methodologique, esprit d'analyse issu de la theorie des jeux et engagement associatif sont autant de qualites que je m'engage a apporter a Swisscom. Je me tiens a votre entiere disposition pour un entretien afin de discuter de vive voix de la maniere dont je pourrais contribuer a vos projets d'IA generative.

Je vous prie d'agreer, Madame, Monsieur, l'expression de mes salutations distinguees.

Badroudine Bacar

bullets: Engineered a high-performance vector similarity service using FastAPI and Docker, achieving sub-40ms latency.

data.coverLetter: Dear Hiring Committee at the Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology (LIST), I am writing to express my strong interest in the Applied AI & NLP internship position. As a final-year engineering student at EILCO specializing in AI and Data Science, I have developed a deep technical proficiency in foundation models and vector embeddings, which aligns directly with the research objectives of your team. My academic background, rooted in the rigorous training of CPGE TSI, has equipped me with the analytical mindset necessary for high-level research. During my recent projects, I successfully engineered a RAG pipeline that achieved a hallucination rate of less than 2% through advanced prompt engineering and Pydantic-based validation. Furthermore, my work on the VectorWord project demonstrated my ability to deploy scalable, low-latency NLP services using FastAPI and Docker. I am particularly drawn to LIST’s reputation for excellence in applied research and the opportunity to work on multilingual NLP challenges. I am fully prepared to contribute to your research initiatives within your hybrid working model, as I value both the collaborative environment of your modern offices and the focus required for deep technical work. My English proficiency, certified at C1 level (TOEIC 905), ensures that I can effectively communicate findings and collaborate within your international research environment. I am eager to bring my technical skills in model optimization and my passion for data science to your team. Thank you for your time and consideration. I look forward to the possibility of discussing how my background in AI research can support the ongoing projects at LIST.
